name: WF-416 — Buyer Matching & Disposition Optimization Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Buyer Matching Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const buyers=Array.isArray(ctx.buyers)?ctx.buyers:[]; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const arv=num(d.arv??p.arv); const assignmentPrice=num(d.assignmentPrice??d.purchasePrice); const repairs=num(d.repairs??p.repairs); const propertyType=String(p.propertyType??p.type??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const city=String(p.city??'').toLowerCase(); const state=String(p.state??'').toLowerCase(); const zip=String(p.zip??p.postalCode??''); const eligible=buyers.map(b=>{const buyBox=b.buyBox??{}; const minPrice=num(buyBox.minPrice); const maxPrice=num(buyBox.maxPrice); const strategies=Array.isArray(buyBox.strategies)?buyBox.strategies.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; const geos=Array.isArray(buyBox.geographies)?buyBox.geographies.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; const scoreParts=[]; if(b.active===false||b.suppressed||b.dnc) return {...b,_blocked:'buyer_blocked'}; if(maxPrice!==null&&assignmentPrice!==null)scoreParts.push(assignmentPrice<=maxPrice?25:0); if(minPrice!==null&&assignmentPrice!==null)scoreParts.push(assignmentPrice>=minPrice?10:0); if(strategies.length)scoreParts.push(strategies.includes(propertyType)?20:0); else scoreParts.push(10); if(geos.length){const target=[city,state,zip].filter(Boolean);scoreParts.push(geos.some(g=>target.some(t=>g.includes(t)))?20:0);} else scoreParts.push(10); if(b.proofOfFundsVerified)scoreParts.push(10); if(b.assignmentEligible)scoreParts.push(5); if(b.responseRate!==undefined)scoreParts.push(Math.max(0,Math.min(5,Number(b.responseRate)*5))); const score=scoreParts.reduce((a,x)=>a+x,0); return {...b,matchScore:Math.round(score),_blocked:null};}).filter(b=>!b._blocked).sort((a,b)=>b.matchScore-a.matchScore); const tiers=eligible.map(b=>({...b,tier:b.matchScore>=80?'A':b.matchScore>=65?'B':b.matchScore>=50?'C':'D'})); const recommended=tiers.filter(b=>b.tier==='A'||b.tier==='B').slice(0,10); const flags=[]; if(!buyers.length)flags.push('no_buyers_available'); if(!recommended.length)flags.push('no_qualified_buyers'); if(assignmentPrice===null)flags.push('missing_assignment_price'); if(arv===null)flags.push('missing_arv'); const optimization= recommended.length? (recommended[0].matchScore>=80?'high_confidence_disposition':'targeted_buyer_distribution'):'expand_buyer_pool'; const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(buyers.length?20:0)+(recommended.length?35:0)+(assignmentPrice!==null?20:0)+(arv!==null?15:0)+(repairs!==null?10:0)))); const idempotencyKey='wf416:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId; return [{json:{...input,buyerMatching:{status:recommended.length?'optimized':'needs_buyer_pool',optimization,recommendedBuyers:recommended.map(b=>({buyerId:b.id??b.buyerId??null,name:b.name??null,matchScore:b.matchScore,tier:b.tier,proofOfFundsVerified:!!b.proofOfFundsVerified,assignmentEligible:!!b.assignmentEligible})),candidateCount:tiers.length,flags,confidenceScore:confidence,distribution:{maxRecipients:10,preferredTiers:['A','B'],excludeInactive:true,excludeSuppressed:true,excludeDNC:true}},idempotencyKey}}];
